datasets.grouping_claim: COph100: grouped by recovered patient identity (56 groups over 491 pairs); splits are patient-disjoint.
notes: Official COph100 v1 annotations and the named source examinations from RIDIRP v1 were checksum-audited. All 324 LabelMe imageData payloads differ from their named examinations and are never used as source images. The 324 named examinations in 100 eye folders yield 491 pairs and map to 56 patient prefixes through the deposited copy helper's patient/stage convention.
